channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: K-FOOD CLASS
channel.desc: Chef Joseph Lidgerwood?s class is? A Little Too Special! A K-FOOD experience crafted like no other ? Now Open! As global interest in Korean culture continues to thrive, K-FOOD has become one of its most compelling pillars. And today, people aren?t just curious about how it tastes. They want to learn how it?s made. Joseph Lidgerwood, chef-owner of the Michelin two-star restaurant EVETT, is an Australian chef who has developed a deep connection to Korea?s traditional jang and its ingredients. Now, he?s ready to share what he calls the ?the true taste of Korea.? Each episode welcomes a new group of participants from around the world, learning the all-time favorites such as Korean fried chicken, jaeyuk bokkeum, ganjang gejang, godeungeo kimchijjim, and bajirak sujebi, all reimagined through Joseph?s unique style. The atmosphere in the kitchen, shaped by curiosity, focus, and genuine interaction between Joseph and his students, often becomes as memorable as the food they create. You?ll take home the recipes, of course. But what truly sets this class apart is the moments shared along the way, the laughter, the discoveries, and the way flavor bridges cultures. Experience the depth, joy, and creativity of K-FOOD in Joseph?s A Little Too Special: K-FOOD Class!

channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
channel.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don?t know yet? \"Diplomat?s Archives: Hidden Stories\" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected?bilaterally and multilaterally? and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
channel.desc:
2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They?ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel \"One Left\", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film \"Parasite,\" and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel \"Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982\" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel \"Diary of a Murderer\" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, \"Hysteria,\" as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, \"The Disaster Tourist\", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->
.

Each episode welcomes a new group of participants from around the world, learning the all-time favorites such as Korean fried chicken, jaeyuk bokkeum, ganjang gejang, godeungeo kimchijjim, and bajirak sujebi, all reimagined through Joseph?s unique style. The atmosphere in the kitchen, shaped by curiosity, focus, and genuine interaction between Joseph and his students, often becomes as memorable as the food they create. You?ll take home the recipes, of course. But what truly sets this class apart is the moments shared along the way, the laughter, the discoveries, and the way flavor bridges cultures. channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE A
channel.desc:
2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They?ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel \"One Left\", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film \"Parasite,\" and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel \"Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982\" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel \"Diary of a Murderer\" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, \"Hysteria,\" as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, \"The Disaster Tourist\", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

We invite the most talked-about figures?those who influence not just Korea but the world?into our studio for intimate one-on-one conversations. Through their stories, the secrets behind overcoming failure and achieving success, and even private small talk, we uncover what makes them extraordinary. When you listen to someone?s story, you enter their world. In this time of dialogue with the most Korean yet most global K-people, we step into the K-Universe.[(96057)]

channel.desc: Moo! It's Cow's big moment in the concert, but she just can't moo at the right time. Go, Stop and Do Block Moo help Cow get her confidence back just in time for the show.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Colourblocks
channel.desc: The Printing Crew. Meet the Printing Crew - Yellow, Cyan, and Magenta. Learn how together they can mix lots of colours.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Hey Duggee
channel.desc: The Kite Badge. Animated preschool series. It's a windy day, and the Squirrels want to play outside. Duggee is flying his kite. The Squirrels make their own kites.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Yukee
channel.desc: Water Music. Sonny organises a tea party in his caravan to show off his new musical instrument, but rain comes pouring through the leaky roof. Are his plans for a musical afternoon a washout.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Something Special
channel.desc: Winter. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Justin and his friends go ice skating, and Mr Tumble builds a cosy den in his bedroom using Grandad Tumble's blankets.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Teletubbies
channel.desc: Packing. Preschool series. Tinky Winky puts Dipsy's hat in the bag - and Noo-noo hoovers them both up! The children in Tummy Tales pack a bag for an overnight stay with a relative.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
channel.desc: Raa Raa and Boomy Thunder. Animation set in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. There's a storm in the jungle but no-one is sure what the loud thumps coming from the sky are.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Chuggington
channel.desc: My Hero. When Brewster's hero can't make it for Hero Day, he and Zephie set off on their own hero duty and learn what makes a real hero along the way.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Gigglebiz
channel.desc: Comedy sketch show for younger viewers. Lovable old storyteller Storybook Stan has problems getting comfortable and Will Singalot infuriates poor Robin Hood with his singing.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
channel.desc: Little Machines. Series for young children that celebrates many different kinds of amazing machines. In this episode, Grace shows off three incredible machines that are all really little.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: The Game Catchers
channel.desc: Beware of the Chomper! On the Undergrowth Planet, the Game Catchers learn to play rowing on the river.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Octonauts
channel.desc: Fiddler Crabs. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. The Octonauts help clean up a beach after a storm.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Peter Rabbit
channel.desc: The Tale of Benjamin's Strawberry Raid. Animated series. Benjamin takes charge of a strawberry harvest raid on Mr McGregor's garden.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Hey Duggee
channel.desc: The Tadpole Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee has made a rock pool, a place of calm for all the animals. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - wriggling dots with tails.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Vida the Vet
channel.desc: Goodnight, Baby Mouse. When Baby Mouse won't take a nap, Vida runs a sleep study to find out why.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Supertato
channel.desc: Operation Jewel. Supertato is determined to rescue Tomato's precious jewel after Evil Pea steals it.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: The Weasy Family
channel.desc: Mission Scarecrow. While playing baseball, Weasy hits a ball out of bounds. It lands on a scary scarecrow, which frightens the Ducklings. Weasy makes fun of them but is scared too.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Mojo Swoptops
channel.desc: Cherry Picker! The town's ferris wheel is stuck, so Mojo and Bo have to get it moving. But they do their job too well, because the wheel rolls away, forcing Mojo and Bo to chase it down.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Bluey
channel.desc: Unicorse. Bluey's bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Bluey
channel.desc: The Show. On Mother's Day, Bluey puts on a play about how Mum and Dad first met.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Piripenguins
channel.desc: Pancake's Party Panic. Pancake reluctantly agrees to a big birthday party but finds his own way to handle it.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Andy's Safari Adventures
channel.desc: Andy and the Grasshopper Mouse. Preschool wildlife series. Andy goes in search of a mystery sound and the animal that makes it, meeting a grasshopper mouse along the way.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
channel.desc: Blockade Waffle. Preschool comedy drama series. Evie is going back to school after the summer holidays. Determined not to be left alone, Waffle hatches a plan to keep her at home.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Meet Rafi the Wishing Wizard
channel.desc: The First Wish. On her seventh birthday, Rafi receives her very first wishing wand. With a few important rules to learn, Rafi is ready to make some very exciting wishes.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
channel.desc: The Bouncy Wish. Rafi's wish for trampoline feet makes bouncing fun, until it becomes too much. With her dads' help, she realises asking for support brings laughter, pancakes and hugs.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
channel.desc: It's Time to Look after Monty. JoJo and Gran Gran are looking after Monty the dog for the day. JoJo learns that there's much more to looking after a dog than just play.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Sarah & Duck
channel.desc: Woolly Memories. Animation. Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: Clangers
channel.desc: Bubble Trouble. Stop-motion animation. Major Clanger has invented a machine for cleaning up the planet. Small and Tiny can't resist trying it for themselves.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: BeddyByes
channel.desc: Floating. MeMo and BaBa enjoy seeing and playing with floaty things.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: In the Night Garden
channel.desc: Wake Up Ball. Children's programme. The ball is bouncing through the garden and lands straight on Upsy Daisy's bed. She tucks the ball in so it can have a rest.

channel.name: CBeebies UK
channel.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
channel.desc: Gok Wan - Eyes that Kiss in the Corners. Join Gok Wan as he tells the story of Mei, who celebrates her family and the beautiful eye shape they all share.[(96057)]

channel.name: Classica DE
channel.title: Golden Age
channel.desc: Das Bolschoi Theaterballett interpretiert Dmitri Schostakowitschs "Golden Age", ein in zwei Akten, mit einer Choreografie von Juri Grigorowitsch. Der russische Choreograph und Co-Librettist des Werks war 18 Jahre lang selbst als Solist des Mariinski-Theaters t?tig und leitete f?r einen kurzen Zeitraum sogar das . Die ersten Produktionen, an denen er am Kirower als Choreograf mitwirkte waren "The Stone Flower" und "The Legend of Love". Sie markieren den Beginn eines neuen Choreografen, der bald auf der ganzen Welt bekannt wurde und Teil einer Bewegung war, die ?ber Jahre die Entwicklung des russischen Ballets ma?geblich beeinflusste. Die Handlung von Golden Age spielt sich in den 1920er Jahren in einer k?stennahen Stadt im S?den Russlands ab. In den 1920ern erlaubte die Neue ?konomische Politik (NEP) es, aktiv private Gesch?fte und Handel zu betreiben, was dazu f?hrte, dass zwielichtige Gesch?fte und kleinkriminelle Ganoven aufbl?hten wie nie zuvor. Das Lokal "Golden Age" ist das Epizentrum solcher Kleinkrimineller. Dort unterhalten Rita, eine junge T?nzerin, die sich als Mademoiselle Margot ausgibt, und ihr Partner Jacques, eigentlich Yashka, die gemeinsam eine lokale Banditengruppe anf?hren, ein Publikum aus "Schnellebenden". W?hrend eines Stadtfestes trifft Rita auf Boris, einen jungen Fischer und Mitglied eines satirischen Theaterensembles, das sich f?r Jugendliche engagiert. Die beiden verlieben sich ineinander und l?sen damit eine Kette von Ereignissen voller Intrigen aus, die die junge Liebe auf die Probe stellt. Aufgenommen 2016 w?hrend einer Performance im Bolschoi Theater in Moskau.

channel.name: Classica DE
channel.title: Schubert ? Sinfonie Nr. 8 in h-Moll: D. 759
channel.desc: Les Dissonances ist ein K?nstlerkollektiv, das 2004 vom Geiger David Grimal gegr?ndet wurde. Das Ensemble ohne Dirigenten besteht aus Musikern der renommiertesten europ?ischen Orchester, internationalen Solisten und jungen Talenten. In dieser Auff?hrung f?hrt Les Dissonances Franz Schuberts Symphonie Nr. 8 in h-Moll, D. 759, auch bekannt als die 'Unvollendete Symphonie', auf. Schubert begann 1822 mit der Komposition des Werkes, vollendete jedoch nur die ersten beiden S?tze. Der erste Satz, Allegro moderato, hat eine dunkle, geheimnisvolle Stimmung, die einen Kontrast zum sch?nen zweiten Satz in E-Dur, Andante con moto, bildet. Schubert notierte nur ein paar Takte des dritten Satzes, eines Scherzos, in voller Partitur. Es ist nicht bekannt, warum der Komponist seine Symphonie nie vollendete, es gibt jedoch mehrere Theorien. Obwohl das Werk nicht vollst?ndig ist, geh?rt es zu Schuberts beliebtesten Kompositionen. Diese Auff?hrung wurde 2013 in der Cit? de la musique in Paris, Frankreich, aufgenommen. Mit dabei: Les Dissonances.

channel.desc: Faszinierend, virtuos und spektakul?r: keine anderen Worte k?nnten die vielseitigen Klavierkompositionen von Franz Liszt besser beschreiben. Genie?en Sie eine schillernde Performance von Liszt 1. Klavierkonzert in Es-Dur, interpretiert von Klaviervirtuoso Daniel Trifonow in Begleitung des Israel Philharmonic Orchestras und Dirigent Kent Nagano. Als Zugabe dieses s dient Reflets dans l'eau aus Debussys Images und das Orchester bringt dieses stargesprickte schlie?lich mit einer Rendition von Mahlers 7. Sinfonie zu einem kr?nenden Abschluss. Aufgenommen 2014 im Charles Bronfman Auditorium in Tel Aviv. Mit dabei: Daniil Trifonov.

channel.name: Classica DE
channel.title: Meisterwerke entdecken
channel.desc: Mit der Serie "Meisterwerke Entdecken" pr?sentieren wir audiovisuelle Konzertf?hrer der gro?en Meisterwerke der klassischen Musik. Die Serie enth?lt 20 halbst?ndige en ?ber 20 Meisterwerke der Klassik. Angesehene Experten, ber?hmte Solisten und herausragende Dirigenten versetzen Sie zur?ck in die Zeit und an die Orte ihrer Entstehung. In der heutigen geht es um Ludwig van Beethovens ?Sinfonie Nr. 5'. Das St?ck ?bt gleich zu Beginn mit dem Vierton-"Schicksalsmotiv" eine starke Anziehungskraft aus und zieht den Zuh?rer in seinen Bann. Der deutsche Musikwissenschaftler Armin Koch besch?ftigt sich mit der Analyse des Werkes und der deutsche Beethoven-Experte Wulf Konold veranschaulicht die raffinierten Variationen des Schicksalsmotivs auf dem Klavier und erl?utert au?erdem weitere Merkmale dieses gro?artigen Werks.

channel.name: Classica DE
channel.title: Orchestra Final ? Liszt Competition 2017
channel.desc: Dina Ivanova (1994, Russia) performs Franz Liszt's Piano Concerto No. 1 (S124), during the final of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht 2017. The competition actively presents, develops and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians. The International Franz Liszt Piano Competition was founded in 1986 in the Netherlands and since has built a reputation as one of the world's most prestigious piano competitions.

channel.name: Classica DE
channel.title: Giuseppe Verdi: Nabucco
channel.desc: Der israelische Dirigent Daniel Oren leitet das Orchester der Arena di Verona in einer gro?artigen Interpretation von Giuseppe Verdis Nabucco von 2017. Verdis dritte ? und sein erster echter Erfolg ? wurde 1842 f?r das Teatro alla Scala in Mailand kreiert, dem damaligen Epizentrum des "Risorgimento" und Hauptstadt des italienischen Nationalismus zu einem Zeitpunkt an dem die Verfechter der italienischen Unabh?ngigkeit von der ?sterreichischen Besetzung sich nach und nach Geh?r verschafften. Ein Auszug aus Va, pensiero, sull'ali dorate (deutsch: "Flieg, Gedanke, auf goldenen Schwingen"), den die Juden im dritten Akt singen, nachdem sie durch Nabuchodonosor aus Babylon verbannt wurden und um ihre Heimat trauern, fand schnell Anklang unter den italienischen Nationalisten und gilt seitdem als Symbol der italienischen Nationalidentit?t. Daniel Oren gilt als echter Kenner Verdis und gern gesehener Gast der Arena di Verona. Er dirigiert dieses "lyrisch epische Werk", das den Italienern so sehr am Herzen liegt, mit gro?em Elan. Unter den Solisten sind George Gagnidze, Susanna Branchini, Nino Surguladze, Rubens Pelizzari und Stanislav Trofimov. Diese Aufnahme entstand w?hrend einer Auff?hrung 2017 in der Arena di Verona. Mit dabei: Sebastian Catana Rubens Pelizzari Stanislav Trofimov Susanna Branchini Nino Surguladze Elena Borin Paolo Antognetti Nicol? Ceriani.

The program aims to explore the fundamental values and principles of American society, politics, culture, and current events and the impact that these things have on the nation's future and the everyday lives of the citizens. Levin also hosts "The Mark Levin Show," and prior to joining FOX, he served as an adviser to some of President Ronald Reagan's cabinet members.

channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Magical Japanese
channel.desc: The Japanese people's coexistence with nature has led to many words and expressions related to kusa or \"grass\" taking root in the Japanese language.

channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
channel.desc: Gojinjo Taiko is a wild, powerful performance by masked drummers. It originated 400 years ago in the small coastal community of Nafune-machi in Ishikawa Prefecture. The story goes that, faced with an imminent attack by a powerful warlord, villagers used improvised masks to disguise themselves as oni (demons), and scared away the approaching forces. Gojinjo Taiko is performed not only at the summer matsuri (festival) but at local hotels in everyday life, as a form of community revitalization.

channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
channel.desc: Gojinjo Taiko is a wild, powerful performance by masked drummers. It originated 400 years ago in the small coastal community of Nafune-machi in Ishikawa Prefecture. The story goes that, faced with an imminent attack by a powerful warlord, villagers used improvised masks to disguise themselves as oni (demons), and scared away the approaching forces. Gojinjo Taiko is performed not only at the summer matsuri (festival) but at local hotels in everyday life, as a form of community revitalization.

channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Activate Your Japanese!
channel.desc: Drama \"Xuan Tackles Japan!\"\nTime has passed, and the hotel's autumn campaign has been a success. Rei then tells Xuan that he is quitting his job at the hotel to go to France. Unable to process this sudden revelation, Xuan shrinks from talking to Rei even on the day of his departure. But she knows she needs to talk to him before he leaves, and she hurries after him to the airport. Xuan wants to express her feelings and gratitude to Rei. Will she be able to say what she wants to say? What should she do if she feels unsure of her Japanese?\n\"Onomatopoeia\" -Share Feelings- Kotsukotsu.
